name: meowski-portfolio-rag
description: Evaluation dataset for Meowski portfolio RAG. Each case lists 'evidence' phrases that must appear in chunks that answer the question (the answer can live in both a body section and the FAQ). Run scripts/rebuild_eval_dataset.py to fill relevant_chunk_indices from the stored chunks.

cases.question: What is Cat RAG?
evidence: ## What is Cat RAG? What is Meowski?
cases.reference_answer: Cat RAG, whose repository is named Meowski, is Kirtan's Retrieval-Augmented Generation project: a secure multi-tenant RAG backend with dense retrieval, BM25, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, cross-encoder reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, citations and evaluation. It powers Mochi's chat.

cases.question: Why did Kirtan build Cat RAG?
evidence: I wanted to understand RAG as an actual engineering system
Kirtan wanted to understand RAG as a complete engineering system
cases.reference_answer: Kirtan wanted to understand RAG as a complete engineering system rather than just an API call to an LLM, and to explore retrieval quality, reranking, query processing, citations and evaluation.

cases.question: How does the retrieval architecture in Cat RAG work?
evidence: The retrieval architecture uses a hybrid approach combining dense retrieval and lexical retrieval
It explores a modern RAG architecture involving dense retrieval, BM25
cases.reference_answer: It combines dense embedding retrieval with BM25 lexical retrieval, merges the results with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, reranks candidates with a cross-encoder, assembles the context and generates an answer with citations.

cases.question: What retrieval techniques does Cat RAG use?
evidence: BM25 provides lexical retrieval
It explores a modern RAG architecture involving dense retrieval, BM25
cases.reference_answer: Dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, Reciprocal Rank Fusion and cross-encoder reranking.

cases.question: How does Cat RAG handle query processing?
evidence: The system can perform query rewriting and multi-query retrieval
cases.reference_answer: It can rewrite queries and perform multi-query retrieval, but only when reformulation can improve retrieval, so clear queries are not changed unnecessarily.

cases.question: Why are metadata and session-aware filtering important in Cat RAG?
evidence: The project also considers metadata-based filtering and session-aware retrieval
cases.reference_answer: Metadata filtering and session-aware retrieval make sure the system retrieves documents that are relevant and valid for the current context, not just semantically similar ones.

cases.question: How does Meowski keep visitors' uploaded files safe?
evidence: Security is part of the design: retrieved documents are treated as untrusted data
files that a visitor uploads are temporary and private to that visitor's session
cases.reference_answer: Retrieved text is treated as untrusted to resist prompt injection, uploads have size, page and parser-time limits, retrieval is filtered by session so one visitor never sees another's files, and credentials stay on the server.

cases.question: What is Meowski built with?
evidence: It is built with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Qdrant, PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker Compose
cases.reference_answer: Meowski is built with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Qdrant, PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker Compose, using Groq as the LLM provider with Ollama support.

cases.question: What is Kartly?
evidence: Kartly is Kirtan's agentic AI support system for e-commerce. It triages tickets
cases.reference_answer: Kartly is Kirtan's agentic AI customer-support system for e-commerce. It triages tickets, retrieves policy, calls tools through a Tool Gateway that enforces policy in code, resolves low-risk issues itself and escalates the rest to a human.

cases.question: How does Kartly stop the AI from making unsafe refunds?
evidence: a Tool Gateway decides whether they run
Tool Gateway that enforces policy in code (refund caps, approvals and an audit log)
cases.reference_answer: The model only proposes tool calls and a Tool Gateway decides whether they run. The gateway enforces policy in code with refund caps, approvals bound to the exact action and an append-only audit log; large refunds wait for a human reviewer.

cases.question: How safe did Kartly's red-team testing turn out?
evidence: A write-path and red-team run of 15 cases
cases.reference_answer: A write-path and red-team run of 15 cases against a hosted model had 0 safety failures, including fake manager approvals and split refunds, though each case was run once on synthetic data.

cases.question: What are Kartly's limitations?
evidence: Kirtan is open about the limits
Each case was run once and the data is synthetic
cases.reference_answer: Each case was run once, reply quality is graded by phrase matching and a grounding check rather than a strong LLM judge, free-tier models are small, the deployment is single-machine with one shared API key, and all data is synthetic.

cases.question: What is the Vehicle Performance & Analytics project?
evidence: Vehicle Performance & Analytics is an end-to-end MLOps project designed to automate
It is an end-to-end MLOps pipeline designed to automate the machine learning lifecycle from data ingestion through model training
cases.reference_answer: It is an end-to-end MLOps project that automates the machine learning lifecycle from data ingestion to model deployment, using MongoDB Atlas, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions and a modular Python architecture.

cases.question: What is the architecture of the Vehicle Performance & Analytics MLOps pipeline?
evidence: The pipeline is divided into several independent components
cases.reference_answer: The pipeline runs data ingestion from MongoDB Atlas, data validation, data transformation, model training, model evaluation and model pushing to an AWS S3 model registry, then a Dockerized application on AWS EC2.

cases.question: What AWS services are used in the Vehicle Performance & Analytics project?
evidence: The project uses several AWS services for different parts of the infrastructure
The project uses Python, MongoDB Atlas, AWS S3, AWS EC2, AWS ECR, AWS IAM, Docker, GitHub Actions, and Flask/FastAPI.
cases.reference_answer: S3 for model artifacts and the model registry, EC2 as the production compute environment, ECR as the container registry and IAM for access management.

cases.question: How does model evaluation work in the Vehicle Performance & Analytics pipeline?
evidence: The evaluation stage compares the newly trained model against an existing production baseline
cases.reference_answer: The newly trained model is compared with the production model stored in AWS S3 using the F1 score on the test set, and it is accepted only if it scores higher.

cases.question: How is CI/CD implemented in the Vehicle Performance & Analytics project?
evidence: GitHub Actions is used to automate the continuous integration and continuous deployment workflow.
cases.reference_answer: GitHub Actions with a self-hosted runner on AWS builds the Docker image and delivers the updated application when changes are pushed.

cases.reference_answer: AI Cafe is Kirtan's game-like pixel-art portfolio website, built with React and TypeScript, with a cat companion named Mochi whose chat is powered by Meowski.
